readerCopy.body: A familiar arrangement can still provide comfort while asking for a sacrifice that has become harder to keep making. When the Moon opposes Lilith, care and autonomy face each other directly, bringing home, family, routine, or relationship stability into conflict with a need for more privacy, rest, help, or say. Familiarity can remain valuable without making the cost imaginary. The arrangement becomes easier to judge once the recurring sacrifice is named too.
